key_difference: (D) also routes QObjectPrivate::removeConnection (QObject::disconnect(Connection) from any thread) through the new posting path and falls back to an inline cross-thread virtual call when the sender's QThread is null or not running, whereas (B) changes only the receiver-destruction path in ~QObject and never makes the virtual call off the sender's thread (it posts a dedicated QDisconnectNotifyEvent only if the thread has an event dispatcher, and otherwise skips the notification).
